summary.en: Look up customer conversations and tickets

description.zh: 读取联系人、对话与工单，搜索历史沟通记录并添加回复或备注。适合客服场景里快速了解用户背景。首次连接在浏览器登录 Intercom 授权。
description.en: Read contacts, conversations, and tickets, search past exchanges, and add replies or notes. Useful in support work to get a customer's context fast. Sign in to Intercom in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Intercom 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Intercom and authorize on first connect
